source.title: Utilizing the planarian voltage-gated ion channel transcriptome to resolve a role for a Ca2+ channel in neuromuscular function and regeneration

intervention.description: Control RNAi (Smed-six-1) worms fed over several feeding/regeneration cycles; trunk fragments bathed in praziquantel 70 uM for 24 h from cutting.

readout.method: visual scoring of regenerative anterior-posterior polarity

notes: Mean percentage of two-headed regenerants across independent trials (+/-2; error type not stated in text); n per arm not stated (methods: n>30 worms per regenerative assay), so n_total null and percentages entered as counts. Remainder (100 - two-headed) assigned to normal by assumption; the paper reports only the two-headed fraction. Background is negative-control RNAi (Smed-six-1). Paper does not state the molecular target of praziquantel.
